known_risks: The tested checkpoint is an unofficial 4-bit conversion, not a locally converted official BF16 artifact.
Clone and voice-direction output levels are low relative to the design samples.
CLI streaming works, but cold end-to-end first chunk latency is far from the upstream H100 fast path claim.
The CLI reports per-chunk RTF using cumulative elapsed time and chunk-only duration, so later chunk RTF values are not comparable metrics.
Event presence still requires listening or a dedicated event detector; ASR only proves spoken-text fidelity.
The upstream HTTP streaming API has not been verified in MLX.
